_doc: Keep-out boxes for platform/parts/slice-check.py (#70), in each STL's OWN coordinates (as the file sits in parts/printed or cad/derived): {"<stl file name>": [{"name": "air channel", "min": [x, y, z], "max": [x, y, z]}]}. Support G-code inside a box fails the check. The A4Tv2 duct's air channel goes here once #59 picks the print orientation.
